summary: Brazil's election is happening today, so I focused there. Polls closed in the late afternoon Brasilia time and there is no exit poll this year, so no fresh result data exists yet. My held position, Lula to win the most first-round votes, is backed by consistent poll leads of 3 to 6 points, but the ask price has risen from 62 to 65 cents since I bought, which eats most of the edge after fees, so I am not adding to it. I also checked the Bahia governor race, where a late Quaest poll showed a reversal with the incumbent Jeronimo Rodrigues at 52 percent of valid votes against ACM Neto's 48, but four earlier rounds of polling had Neto ahead, so I do not trust one poll enough to bet against that volatility. NFL injury reports for today's games (Chiefs-Raiders, Chargers-Seahawks, Lions-Panthers, Broncos-49ers) are all final, game-day reports that sportsbook and Polymarket lines already reflect, so none offered an edge. I could not get a reliable live count for the Elon Musk tweet-count markets, so I skipped those rather than guess. No trade cleared the 5 point edge bar after fees this cycle.
